observations.detail: First anchor checker required full-line leading whitespace equality and stopped at recovery-store.ts:280; subject stores trimmed text. Corrected checker compares trimmed lines and all 34 records pass. No subject mutation or runtime action.

One combined display of sections/law metadata exceeded tool output. Full structured files were subsequently processed without truncation for catalog equality/citations, and targeted semantic source/spec ranges were inspected. No truncated display used as an inventory witness.
